title: Fog, Vision, Sensors, Walls, Doors & Exploration Memory
objective: Extend the completed ISE-01/02 native tactical Scene with player-safe fog, explored-memory, owner-authored perception channels, wall/window/door projections, collision/occlusion previews and explicit GM reveal/door proposals while preserving canonical Scene, Visibility/Permissions, semantic-position, movement and Action/Event ownership.

persistence.reason: ISE-03 consumes existing authorized Scene/Visibility owner state and emits versioned reveal/door proposals; no parallel fog, exploration or door ledger is created.

preserved_boundaries: ISE-01 and ISE-02 remain completed_verified and their implementation authority is not reopened.
A5 authorization-before-projection remains mandatory; hidden/GM-only objects are removed before lookup, aggregation, counts, diagnostics, export or AI context.
A5 Scene and existing Visibility/Permissions ownership remain canonical for map primitives, reveal authority and durable exploration/visibility state.
A7 semantic position and owning movement rules remain canonical; collision/occlusion presentation cannot silently move objects.
A6 Action/Event or the owning object domain remains required for consequential door/reveal state changes; ISE-03 emits proposals only.
Perception/sensor behavior is profile-authored and setting-local; ISE-03 does not create universal sight, darkness, range, sensor or door rules.
ISE-04+ feature scope, paid provider activation, unauthorized media redistribution, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
